reason: The dedicated Advanced AI screen renders headline.title directly, so translate and replace that field only while the saved app language is Hindi.

required_checks: Hindi live-headline rendering regression using the currently reported Sudan, China and Iran titles
validation.root_cause: Earlier fixes populated title_hi, but AdvancedAiTabScreen ignored title_hi and displayed headline.title, leaving visible headlines in English.
validation.news_fix: The fetch runtime now reads okai_lang. In Hindi mode it obtains embedded, deterministic or live translated Hindi text and writes it into both title_hi and title before the dedicated AI screen normalizes the response.
validation.language_behavior: Hindi mode renders Hindi title text. English mode receives and renders the untouched original English title.
validation.cache: Successful live translations are cached to avoid retranslating the same headline every 15 seconds.

trade_safety: Display-only news language correction. No signal, score, strategy, entry, exit, quantity, stop-loss, cooldown, risk, broker or order logic changes.
